description: Source file implementing validation functions for radio configuration parameters in UHD context, including clock sources, frequency, stream, and format validation.

methods.name: validate_clock_sources
methods.description: Validates if the provided clock sources are within the allowed set.

methods.name: validate_lo_freq
methods.description: Checks if the local oscillator frequency is normal (non-zero, finite).

methods.name: validate_args_format
methods.description: Validates the format of argument strings using regex.

methods.name: validate_channel
methods.description: Validates individual channel parameters including frequency, gain, and args.

methods.name: validate_stream
methods.description: Validates a stream consisting of multiple channels and args.

methods.name: validate_sampling_rate
methods.description: Checks if the sampling rate is normal and positive.

methods.name: validate_otw_format
methods.description: Validates if the over-the-wire format is supported.

methods.name: radio_config_uhd_config_validator::is_configuration_valid
methods.description: Main method to validate the entire radio configuration object.
